translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 2 Tesalonicenses
book.title: Tesalónicagi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Irbogus Garda Narmaksad 2 Tesalonicenses

content: Emigindi gwenadgan, anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo, a-danikid-ibagi, bular anmar-urboedgi, an bemarga wilesakwaa sogsun,

melle baisursunnaa yogsaar be-binsaed galemalo, degine, melle yogsaar be gwayemalo, ar dule bemarga sokalir, neg-burgan an daksaye, igi, dule sunmak be itos-dibe, igi, bemarga sokarmar-dibe, ani Pablo, garda narmaksaye, bato Bab-Jesús gannar-danikoed-ibadi nonisunye. Degi-soge bemar itoalir, mer be itomalo, binsa gordimalad.

Mer dule yogsaar be-yardaked be samalo. We-ibagan-danikoed-idu, dulemar-bukidar bina Bab Dummadgi bangumargweloed, geb degine, dule-iskudiid-dakledagoed, we a-dulega bato igar-maid, soo-saila-odurdakleged-negse naoed.
A-dule bela Bab Dummadye bilemalad e-istaradid, degine, bab-dummadye ogannolemaladba bur-dummadye sogdabaloed. Na Bab Dummadyobi Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi sigoed, Bab Dummadyobi na san saoed.
¿Ar bemar insasursi, an bemar-abargi amba gudigu, bato an bega sogsamalad?
Ar emigindi bemar wisid, ibu amba barganai, adi mer we-dule-iskudiid dakledagegar, e-wilubgan nonikoedse.
Ar bato iskued-gantik-igar-dukuar-maidgi dule-istarad-e-wilubgan arbanaid. Unnila dule-wargwen dule-iskana-ganikidi, a, bina onirilegweler-gebed.
Geb degi, bur-bule-dule-iskusad dakledagoed, degine, Bab-Jesús, unnila e-bunnogedgi a-dule-oburgoed, degine, e-gangued-nikadba, na e-danikidgine a-dule-obelogoed.
We dule-bur-bule-iskusad danikoedi, nia-saila-Satanás sogedba danikoed, nue gangued nika, nue ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisurmalad, degine, ibmar-geger-daklemalad gakansaar oyononikoed.
Bela galagwensuli ibmar-iskanagi dulemar-odurdakleged-negse-yoggumaloed yardaknonikoed, ar wemarde igar-napiragwad sunna dule-abonoged abingassurmarsoggu, yardaklemarsunnodo.
A-ulale Bab Dummad yamo gakansaaled barmialid, adi gakan, napiragwadyob abingamalagar.
Adi belagwapa-yapa-igar-napiragwadba-damalad sabsur odurdaklemalagar, ar ade iskued bur-yeer itomaladba, a-ular deyob gunonisunnad.

Gwenadgan, bemar-ular Bab Dummadga dog-nued anmar gusgu sogdaed. Gwenadgan, Bab-Jesús nue be-sabmalad, ar ade Bab Dummad gebe-negasailaunni be-susmalad be-abonomalagar. Bab Dummad Burba Nuedba be abonolesmalad, adi bemar-gwage-swilidik imakegar, degine, igar-napiragwad be abingasmaladbar.
A-ulale Bab Dummad bese gochamalad, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nued-sunna-dule-abonolegedgi anmar bemarga sunmaksagu, adi bemar Dummad-Jesucristoba gannales yeer daklemarmogagar.
Degisoggu gwenadgan, gatik salakarmar, mer akumalo, degine, mer iemarbalo, anmar sunmakar, igi, gardagin-dibe anmar be-odurdaksamaladgi.

Jesucristo, anmar-Dummad-sunnad, degine, Bab Dummad, anmar-Baba, anmar-wile-dakedba anmar-sabgusad, degine, anmar-gwage-bendaked geg-bergued anmarga uksad, degine, nue-bensulidgi ibmar edarbediid anmarga uksabalid, ar ade deyob anmar-imake-wilubsulinad.
A bitigi bemar-gwage-ogannogena-gadin, bemarga gangued ukena-yerban, adi bemar sunmakedgi, degine, adi bela ibmar-nuegan-imakedgi bemar nanamalagar.
